title: Permission change
description: A read permission granted or revoked: who may read what, by an identified permission (REQ-AUZ-7, REQ-AUD-12). Policy answers it with a decision, and a permitted read naming the permission rests on its grant.

request.description: The request's id, which its answer names.

permission.description: The permission's id, which a read check names.

grantee.description: Who holds it: a regulator or a checker.

scope.description: What it lets the grantee read.

at.description: When, by Core's clock, the one it passes as at.
